intro: The managing committee looks after day-to-day work between general body meetings. Names and phone numbers appear here when the association publishes them.

members.duty: Calls meetings and speaks for the association with the ward and government offices.
Supports the president and stands in when the president is away.
Sends notices, keeps minutes, and handles the association’s letters.
Helps with records, follow-up, and the arrangements for meetings.
Keeps collections and payments, and places the accounts before the general body.
